posts.text: Is anyone still following this company? I started looking at it today because, optically, the valuation seems reasonable, but it seems like there are a lot of corporate governance concerns of late. Just attaching a summary of my findings below. Independent reports from the Monitoring Agency (CARE Ratings Limited) , filings with the National Stock Exchange (NSE) , and the company’s own disclosures reveal transactions with entities linked to promoters, unrecovered advances from aborted acquisitions, commingling of issue proceeds, rapid turnover of Chief Financial Officers (CFOs), and a severe di…
